name: system-status
description: Inspect system, CPU, memory, disks and processes
descriptionZh: 系统巡检：CPU、内存、磁盘和进程

name: service-diagnosis
description: Diagnose service status, startup failures and logs
descriptionZh: 服务排查：运行状态、启动失败和日志

name: network-diagnosis
description: Diagnose DNS, ports, routing and connectivity
descriptionZh: 网络排查：DNS、端口、路由和连通性

name: disk-cleanup
description: Analyze disk usage and propose a cleanup plan
descriptionZh: 磁盘清理分析：定位占用并提出清理方案

name: docker-diagnosis
description: Inspect containers, logs and resource usage
descriptionZh: Docker 排查：容器状态、日志和资源占用

name: log-triage
description: Correlate bounded application and system logs
descriptionZh: 日志排查：限定范围并关联错误时间线

name: incident-triage
description: Triage an outage and organize read-only evidence
descriptionZh: 故障分诊：评估影响并组织只读证据

name: deployment-preflight
description: Assess release readiness with evidence, explicit blockers and unverified requirements; never deploy implicitly
descriptionZh: 发布前检查：核对资源、依赖与恢复条件，明确阻塞项和未验证项

name: deployment-verification
description: Verify deployed identity, service stability and expected application behavior against release criteria
descriptionZh: 发布后验收：核对实际版本、服务稳定性与业务验收条件

name: tls-diagnosis
description: Locate DNS, TCP, certificate identity/trust/expiry and HTTPS failures from an explicit vantage point
descriptionZh: 域名与证书排查：区分解析、连接、证书校验与 HTTPS 故障
